    Free fundamental groups of chain-bounded ray categories #

    Fischbacher's iteration (Satz 1.6 b) for finite P): a finite connected chain-bounded ray category with cancellation has a free fundamental group (RayCat.isFreeGroup_end_fund). Each step removes the arrows αᵢ of Lemma 2.1 from P or from Pᵒᵖ; the fundamental group does not change (Lemma 2.2, RayCat.endEquivOp) and the number of arrows drops. Without essential contours the fundamental groupoid is free.
